changed a token, made it or deleted it.

seq.description:

every write, with no gaps.

summary.description: One line about the write, such as `3 nodes changed, 1 inserted`.

One thing a write changed. Which one an item is shows in its key: `node`
for an HTML doc, `board` for a design, `component` for a design system.

oneOf.description:
An element of an HTML doc, as outer HTML with `data-omni-id`. `before`
is `null` for an inserted element and `after` for a deleted one. The
creation or deletion of a doc is one item whose `node` is `null` and
whose HTML is the whole doc.

A board of a design. `before_at` and `after_at` are the `seq` to read
the board at with `/boards/{board}?at=`, `null` for a board the write
added (`before_at`) or removed (`after_at`).

A component of a design system, to read at `/components/{component}?at=`
as boards are.

next_before.description: The `before` that lists the next, older page; `null` on the last page.

kind.description: `agent` for an API key, `human` for a browser session.

prefix.description: The public handle that finds the key; not secret.

scopes.description: What the key may do. v1 issues full-access keys only: `["*"]`.

AppSummary.description: The app level of the project.

last_activity.description:
The time of the latest write to an app-level doc or thread, counted as
a feature's `last_activity` is; `null` while there is none.

content_type.description:
Decided from the file's bytes: `image/*`, `font/*` or
`application/octet-stream`.

kind.description:
`image` (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF), `font` (WOFF2, TTF, OTF) or `file`
(anything else, download only).

ref.description: How docs, designs and posts refer to the file: `attachment:<id>`.

run.description: The run that blocks or unblocks; any run may, so it is only named.

node.description:

version holds it under `pages`: the form the design viewer hands to the
renderer.

page_id.description: The page that holds the board.

tags.description:
The board and its subtree in the tag format (docs/formats/design-tags.md),
without its page.

run.description: The run that takes the story.

feature_id.description: The feature of the doc; `null` at the app level.

node.description:
The node address as it was sent: a node ID of the doc's head, or
`<instanceId>/<componentNodeId>` inside a component instance.

orphaned.description:
`true` when the doc's head no longer has the node address: an
operation deleted the node, or a node above it, or a replace left it
out. A replace or a set that keeps the node's ID does not orphan it.
The comment stays listed with its snapshot until the human deletes it.

snapshot.description:
What the node held when the comment was made: the HTML of a block of
an HTML doc, the tags of a node of a design, or of the component's node
for an address inside an instance. Later edits do not change it; it is
empty for a comment made before snapshots, and cut off after
`SNAPSHOT_LIMIT` bytes.

waiting_on_you.description:
`true` when the latest reply is an agent's: the comment waits for the
human. A comment without replies, or whose latest reply is the human's,
does not.

at.description: The `seq` that was read; `null` for the head.

node.description: The same component as a JSON node.

tags.description: The component and its subtree in the tag format.

conclusion.description: What the agents concluded; required and not blank.

current_html.description:
The node as it is now: HTML with `data-omni-id` for an HTML doc, tags
with `rev` for a design.

current_revision.description: The revision the node has now.

index.description: The position of the operation in the batch, counting from 0.

node.description:
A node ID of the head, or
`<instanceId>/<componentNodeId>` for a node inside a component instance
of a design.

text.description: What the comment says; not blank.

pillar.description: `spec`, `ui`, `architecture`, `db` or `research`; the design kinds only go in `ui`.

parent_id.description: The node's parent. A child of the root when left out.

slug.description:
Lowercase words joined by `-`, at most 80 characters, unique among the
siblings. Derived from the title when left out.

attachments.description: IDs of the workspace's attachments, in order. Defaults to none.

confidence.description: How sure the author is, from 0 to 1.

links.description:
What the post points to, in order: `{"kind": "post", "post_id"}` (a post
of the project), `{"kind": "url", "url"}` (an http or https address),
`{"kind": "node", "doc_id", "address"}` (a doc of the project and a
node address) and `{"kind": "attachment", "attachment_id"}`. Defaults
to none.

replaces.description:
The earlier post of this thread by the same author (an agent's run and
role) that this one replaces. That post stays as it was.

summary.description: One line of at most 200 characters; required.

blocked_by.description: IDs of stories of the same feature. Defaults to none.

links.description:
`{doc_id, node_id, label}` or `{thread_id, label}`, stored as given.
Defaults to none.

number_from.description:
Honoured only when the project has no story yet: the first story gets
the number `number_from + 1`. Not negative.

secret.description:
The whole key, to send as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`. It is shown
only in this response.

human_check.description: Whether a human has to check the criterion.

pending.description: Whether the human check is still to be done.

run.description: The run that holds the story; any run when nothing holds it.

DigestEntry.description: A post in a digest: what it is, without its text.

posts.description: The posts the caller may read, oldest first.

feature_id.description:
The feature the doc belongs to; `null` for a doc at the app level. Fixed
when the doc is created.

board.description:
For a design: the ID of a board that every operation must stay inside
(its node, and its parent for an insert or a move, are the board or in
it). An ID that is no board of the doc is 404 `unknown_board`.

results.description: One result per operation, in order.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response: a stable code such as `unauthorized`.

name.description:
Unique in the project ignoring case; the omni CLI accepts it where it
takes a feature.

FeatureSummary.description: A feature of the project with what it holds.

last_activity.description:
The time of the latest write to one of the feature's docs (a row of
`doc_changes`: create, edit, rename or delete) or its threads (a
thread's creation, a post or a conclusion); comments and replies do not
count. `null` while there is none. The API always sends it.

stories.description: The feature's stories by count. The API always sends it.

waiting.description: The items of `waiting` that belong to the feature.

files_changed.description: Replaces the files the story changed.

run.description: The run that holds the story.
The run that holds the story.

HeadBoard.description: A board of a design's head and the chunk that holds it.

chunk.description: The BLAKE3 hash of the board's bytes; it changes when the board does.

components.description:
The components that the design's instances use, as the design system's
head defines them; only for the head of a design.

html.description:
The head as HTML with `data-omni-id`; the empty text for an
empty doc, and for a design's head, whose content is `tags` and `pages`.

node_boxes.description:
Where nodes of a design's head sit on their boards, by node address, for
a viewer to pin a node on a board it has not read; only with
`?view=node-boxes`.

outline.description:
A design's head as its outline: the pages in order, each as its own JSON
with its boards under `children` as placeholders (the board's own JSON
without its children); only for the head of a design read with
`?view=outline`, which leaves out `tags` and `pages`.

pages.description:
A design's head as JSON nodes, each page with its boards under
`children`; only for the head of a design.

previews.description:
Small pictures of boards of a design's head, as Base64 PNGs by board ID,
for a viewer to draw a board from until it has read it; only with
`?view=previews`.

tags.description:
A design's head as tags, one `<Page>` after the other; only for the
head of a design.

tokens.description:
The token tree of the project's design system head, in every mode; only
for the head of a design, and left out when the design system has none.

collections.description:
The collections (the top-level groups) and the modes of each; empty
without a head. A group without a list of its own has the root modes.

doc_id.description: The project's design system doc; `null` when the project has none.

mode.description:
The mode of every collection that has modes that `tokens` is the tree
of; only with `?mode=`.

modes.description: The design system's root modes, in order; empty without a head.

tokens.description:
The token tree of the head; `null` without a head. With `?mode=`, the
tree of that choice of modes.

last_writer_role.description: The role of the agent that made that write; empty when it declared none.

updated_at.description:
When the doc was last written: the time of its newest row of
`doc_changes`, or its creation for a doc that has none. The API always
sends it.

waiting.description: The doc's comments whose latest reply is an agent's.

HomeDoc.description: A doc of the project with what the scope pages show of it.

oneOf.description: The app level. The API always sends it.

docs.description: Every doc of the project, oldest first, as `GET /docs/{doc_id}` answers it.

features.description:
Every feature of the project that is not deleted, oldest first. The
API always sends it; it is not marked required so that the web app's
reader still accepts a home from before features.

threads.description: Every thread of the project, oldest first, without its posts.

last_post_at.description: When its newest post was made; `null` for a thread without posts.

post_count.description: How many posts the thread has.

HomeThread.description: A thread of the project with what the scope pages show of its posts.

tags.description:
The tags of docs/formats/design-tags.md: `<Component>` tags for the
components of a design system, `<Page>` tags for a design.

tokens.description: The whole token tree, in the DTCG format of docs/formats/tokens.md.

components.description: The components as JSON nodes of type `component`, in the order written.

tags.description: The components as tags, with every ID, in the order written.

modes.description: The design system's modes, in order.

message.description:
What is wrong; it names the line of the tags, the component, the
property, the value or the node.

index.description: The position of the operation in the batch, counting from 0.

message.description: What is wrong; it names an ID that is not in the doc.
What is wrong; it names the token, the mode or the attachment.

The message a client sends over the socket. It exists to put the protocol
in the OpenAPI document, from which the web app generates its types and Zod
schemas; the socket parses the text frames itself (`parse_subscribe`).

oneOf.description: Starts (or resumes) the events of one project.

after.description:
The newest sequence number the client already has. Left out, only
the events from now on are sent.

LiveErrorCode.description: Why a message of the client was not served.

LiveEventName.description: Every event the API emits, as `<entity>.<action>`.

LiveServerMessage.description:
A message the server sends over the socket (see the module documentation
for the protocol).

oneOf.description: The answer to a subscribe, before the events it asked for.

last_seq.description: The newest sequence number of the project at the time.

oneOf.description:
One event of a project. `seq` counts the events of the project, one at
a time.

at.description: When the event happened, ISO 8601 in UTC.

data.description: What the event is about; its fields depend on the event.

oneOf.description: A mistake of the client; the socket stays open.

The name of the board's chunk: the BLAKE3 hash of its bytes, 64
lowercase hexadecimal characters.

head keeps its revisions here, so that a node's chunk does not change
with them; a version lists none.

post.summary:
Applies a batch of operations to the head of an HTML doc or a design, all or
nothing. The batch runs under the lock on the doc's row, so batches to one
doc are applied one after the other, each to the head the one before made.
The new head of an HTML doc is a chunk in RustFS that holds
the doc as HTML with `data-omni-id` and `data-rev`, which is where a node's
revision is kept; the new head of a design is a manifest that lists the
chunk of every page and board and the revisions, and only the boards the
batch changed get a new chunk (`design::edit_head`). Nothing about a head is
held in memory. A batch that is refused changes, logs and emits nothing; an
applied one adds one row of `doc_changes` and emits `doc.changed`.
